ConnectionStrings._comment: Set ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection through User Secrets or the shell. Never commit a real database password.

Security._comment: Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Set via User Secrets: dotnet user-secrets set 'Security:EncryptionKey' '<value>'. Missing in Development is a warning (not fatal); missing in Production blocks startup.

Hangfire._comment: Development uses in-process Hangfire storage. Non-development environments use the compatible Redis adapter.
